id.description: Server-assigned unique identifier of the template.

tenantId.description: ID of the tenant that owns this template.

createdAt.description: Timestamp the template was created, ISO-8601.

createdBy.description: ID of the user who created the template.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp the template was last updated, ISO-8601.

updatedBy.description: ID of the user who last updated the template.

description.description: Free-text description of the template's purpose.

entityType.description: Entity type this template maps: `practitioner`, `facility`, or `group`. Immutable after creation.

outputFormat.description: Output file format produced by exports run from this template, e.g. `csv`.

separator.description: Delimiter used in the output CSV.

version.description: Version number, incremented on each successful update. Not incremented by delete.

mappingsCsvUrl.description: GCS URL of the current mapping CSV for this template version.

rowExpansionKeys.description: JSON array of field keys that trigger row expansion on export. Each key names an array-valued field of the entity; on export one output row is emitted per element of that array instead of collapsing the array into a single cell. Supported keys: `locations`, `networks`, `groups`, `specialties`, `licenses`, `contacts`, `accreditations`, `addressType2Npi`. Null or an empty array means no expansion (one row per entity). As supplied on create/update.

extExportConfig.description: External export destination and sensitive-field configuration, as supplied on create/update. Recognized blocks: `bigquery` (`{"enabled": boolean, "dataset": string, "tableName": string}`) and `sensitive_fields` (per-field exposure mode, e.g. `{"ssn": "masked"}`; only `ssn` supported today, values `full` or `masked`).

scheduleEnabled.description: Whether scheduled (unattended) exports are enabled for this template.

scheduleFrequency.description: Schedule cadence: `daily`, `weekly`, `monthly`, or `custom`. Null when no schedule is configured.

scheduleTime.description: Time of day the schedule runs, 24-hour `HH:mm`. Null when scheduleFrequency is `custom` or no schedule is configured.

scheduleDayOfWeek.description: Day of week the schedule runs: 1 = Sunday ... 7 = Saturday. Only set when scheduleFrequency=`weekly`.

scheduleDayOfMonth.description: Day of month (1-31) the schedule runs. Only set when scheduleFrequency=`monthly`.

scheduleCron.description: Quartz cron expression (6-7 fields, not standard 5-field Unix cron) defining the schedule. Only set when scheduleFrequency=`custom`.

scheduleTimezone.description: IANA timezone identifier the schedule runs in, e.g. `America/New_York`.

scheduleDaysOfWeek.description: Comma-separated days of week the schedule runs: 1 = Sunday ... 7 = Saturday. Only set when scheduleFrequency=`weekly`.

scheduleInterval.description: Interval in hours between runs (1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8 or 12 — divisors of 24). Only set when scheduleFrequency=`hourly`.

lastExportAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent export run from this template, ISO-8601. Null if no export has run yet.

nextExportAt.description: Timestamp of the next scheduled export run, ISO-8601. Null when scheduling is disabled.

metadata.description: Arbitrary caller-defined metadata stored with the template. Not interpreted by the service; persisted and returned as-is.

jobType.description: Derived export trigger type for the Activity Center UI: `SCHEDULED` when a schedule is enabled, `MANUAL` otherwise. Not persisted by the data store.

createdByName.description: Display name resolved from createdBy, when resolvable. Null if resolution failed or has not been attempted; callers should fall back to createdByEmail then createdBy in that case.

createdByEmail.description: Email resolved from createdBy, when resolvable. Null if resolution failed or has not been attempted; used as the display fallback between createdByName and the raw createdBy id.

exportType.description: Export type (CP-41057): `FULL_ROSTER_EXPORT` (default; legacy rows read as this) or `CHANGE_FILE` (rows are the changes in a window).

triggerMode.description: Trigger mode of a Change File template (CP-41062): `SCHEDULED` (generates on its own schedule) or `MANUAL` (generates only through the trigger API with an explicit date range). Null for full roster exports.
